ns2:course.label: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Navigation and Control
ns2:course.description: Design, analysis, and application of decision algorithms to modern aerospace systems: global positioning systems, air traffic control systems, unmanned aerial vehicles, imaging and communication satellites, and planetary ground vehicles. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: AE 202, AE 352, AE 353, AE 370, IE 300, and PHYS 212.
